text:
jenna: Heads up — Alex's 5-year mark is next Wed (12:30pm). thinking small in-office thing? :tada: :birthday:
omar: cupcakes or a plant?
priya: plant pls, our fridge is chaotic and sometimes they prefer less sugar :sweat_smile:
sam: can we do a tiny donation to Alex's fav org instead? they mentioned beach cleanups before :ocean:
hr-bot: Reminder: Alex — 5yr tenure celebration scheduled Wed 12:30-13:15. RSVP here: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1799001112
lena: i'm in for lunch + card. can't bring cake this week though
marco: i can pick up cupcakes Tue morning from SugarRush. how many?
jenna: ideal: 12. any dietary prefs? chocolate, lemon, vegan?
omar: vegan option please — Alex is dairy-free
priya: +1 vegan option
sam: i'll order a small desk succulent too if people are cool with combining gifts
lena: vote: :cake: cake / :seedling: plant / :moneybag: donation
priya: :seedling:
omar: :cake:
sam: :seedling:
marco: :cake:
jenna: current tally 2 cake, 2 plant (counting me), 0 donation
jenna: proposal: small vegan cupcakes + succulent for desk. keeps sugar options but also plant
priya: sounds perfect
marco: will order 14 cupcakes (2 spares) and 1 small succulent. will post pickup ETA
marco: order note:
```
SugarRush — 14 mini cupcakes (4 vegan vanilla, 6 chocolate, 4 lemon)
Small succulent in kraft pot
Pickup Tuesday 9:30am
```
jenna: thanks marco! lena can you grab a card from the front desk on Tue?
lena: yep got it
omar: i'll bring candles + lighter (if we actually blow them)
sam: i'll add a kudos post on the company board: "Alex — five years of making inference cheaper and our lives easier" :clap:
jenna: can folks drop 5-10 words for the card here and i'll compile
priya: "Thanks for helping me untangle that KV cache bug — you're a savior!"
omar: "Best debugging partner for late-night OOMs."
lena: "Always shares snacks and great advice. Congrats!"
marco: "Thanks for the mentoring on routing policies — big impact."
sam: "Appreciate your cost-consciousness and quiet problem-solving."
alex: wow you folks — not sure this is a surprise but i appreciate it all ❤️
jenna: low-key it is fine if not a surprise, just want to celebrate. see you Wed 12:30 (conf C) :balloon:
hr-bot: Calendar updated: Team Lunch — Alex 5yr (Add to your calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1799001112)
jenna: final checklist: cupcakes (marco), succulent (sam), card (lena), forks/plates (marco), lighter (omar). any volunteers for gift wrap?
priya: i'll do a tiny wrap + ribbon
jenna: perfect. closing thread — thanks all! :tada:
